text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm cruising through the mall on my<n>day off when I
spot a familiar face in<n>front of a boutique.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How about this ring? It has a nice<n>color, and it's
high-quality. Not a bad<n>choice, if you ask me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hayahide. You know that's an ear<n>cuff, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh?! It looks exactly like a ring... but<n>it's not...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. Sorry, that was a little<n>disconcerting...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous asked me to help choose<n>a gift for
Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
What do I do?! What do I dooo?! My<n>marvelous
sense isn't tingling at all!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Marvelous, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oh, goody. So, listen. Mayano won a<n>race! ☆ And I
want to give her a<n>marvelous present to celebrate.
★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
But Mayano says she wants<n>something that'll help
her become a<n>"grown-up woman"!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Whatever could that be? Is it sweet?<n>Is it savory?
Is it hot? Cold? I just<n>don't have a cluuue! ☆
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I ended up here<n>helping her out.
Taishin's come to<n>lend a hand too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide's always gotta stick her<n>nose in other
people's business...<n>Anyway, where did Marvelous
run<n>off to?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's Marvelous for you, such a<n>free spirit.
Something else must have<n>caught her eye, so let's
just<n>message her later.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Getting back to the matter at<n>hand—we've got to
find something<n>that will help Mayano feel like a
"grown-up woman."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But how do you define an adult<n>woman in the first
place? By her age?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Listening to Biwa Hayahide, I can't<n>help feeling
she's getting caught up<n>on the specifics.
choice_data_list: Why don't you try a simpler approach?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? Simpler?
choice_data_list: Just go with something you both like.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You have a point. If we don't even<n>like the gift, it
probably won't convey<n>our feelings very well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Okay, Taishin. Let's each find one gift<n>candidate.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After some time, they both come back<n>holding
potential gifts to compare.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide has chosen red nail<n>polish, while
Narita Taishin presents a<n>pair of silver earrings.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now for the impartial opinion. Trainer,<n>which do you
think would be the<n>better choice?
choice_data_list: The bold nail polish Hayahide chose.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you concur with my pick?
choice_data_list: Yeah... but what made you go with that?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, I thought back to the outfit I<n>wore for the
recent holiday party.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I had my nails done to match, you<n>see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It was quite fascinating to see how<n>much the color
of your nails can<n>affect your whole look. So, I
thought<n>I'd like for Mayano to enjoy that<n>same
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wow... I had no idea. So that's how<n>you felt before.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin agrees to the nail polish<n>idea, and we
settle on the gift.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayano! Congratulations on your<n>marvelous
victory! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You got me a present?! And it's nailpolish?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoa! This is super grown-up! Withthis on, I'll definitely look extramature, don'tcha think? ♪ Thank youall so much! ☆

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It looks like our gift was quite a<n>hit. It was
well worth us putting our<n>heads together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ohh... Is that so?
choice_data_list: Sure... but what made you pick those?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I remembered what I got<n>Hayahide for the
recent holiday party.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I gave her a pair of silver earrings<n>too... I figured
they didn't look bad,<n>so...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wow. You must've put some thought<n>into finding
an accessory that<n>matched my outfit so nicely.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I was just—anyway, hurry up<n>and make a
decision.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide agrees to the earrings<n>idea, and we
settle on the gift.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayano! Congratulations on your<n>marvelous
victory! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You got me a present?! And it'searrings?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoa! This is super grown-up!Wearing these will make me, like, chicand cool, right? ♪ Thank you all somuch! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh... But what kind of outfit would go<n>well with
these? Pleeease, you've<n>gotta help me pick. ☆

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? You're saying we're not done<n>yet?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Well, it just goes to show how<n>trustworthy
we are. Nothing makes<n>me happier than helping out
the<n>younger students.
